title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
黄昏。犁好的两块地里面，林枫种下了不少用来制造好伤药的种植物，还在镇上的种子店里面，买了一些辣番果，还有小米辣，芜菁等一些蔬菜种子种了下去。回来的时候，还买了一个鱼缸。为了表示对穿山鼠的谢意。林枫晚上又做了一份辣番面。这可给穿山鼠乐的，将目光放在种植园里面剩下还没有开扩的土地上，那小眼神，就差直接跟林枫说，“这些活也是它的，到时候记得叫它。”...“来，吃糖。”看着将要离开的穿山鼠，林枫拿出了一枚神奇糖果，“穿穿？”穿山鼠有些疑惑的用爪子接过。“好吃的。”穿山鼠嗅了一下，也没多想，直接一口吃了下去。吞下之后，只觉得一天的劳作都清爽了下来，好像更有精神和力量了。憨憨的穿山鼠也没多想，对着林枫作揖拜了两下之后，便离开了。只有在林枫的探查之眼中可以看出。穿山鼠原本在11—12的能量等级，现在变成了13—14。整体上，提升了两级！“藤藤...”藤藤蛇在旁边发出幽怨的声音。它现在算是知道了。只要是眼前这个人类做的食物，那基本上都是一顶一的美食！“好了，也辛苦你忙了一天，拔了两块地的草了。”林枫蹲下身子，带着莫名的笑容看向藤藤蛇。只是这笑意，笑的藤藤蛇莫名的有些羞臊，在接过糖果后，心中想了想，好像决定了什么一样，将身体凑到了林枫身边，然后低下了头。这模样，好像是在让林枫摸它的头？“哈哈...”林枫情不自禁的乐呵了起来，将糖果递过去的同时，也如愿的将手放在了它的头上。光滑的触感，像是果冻一般，但又带着一分柔顺，轻轻抚摸，还有几分冰凉的感觉。换句话说就是......嗯...手感特佳，做到能让藤藤蛇接受自己摸头，林枫也不再说什么继续吊着它了，而是拿出了一枚精灵球，态度诚恳，落在了它的面前。“藤藤？”藤藤蛇刚将神奇糖果放进嘴里面，还没来得及咀嚼，就看到了一个大大的精灵球放在了自己的面前。咀嚼的动作顿时就停住了，整条蛇尬在了原地。林枫很认真的道，“要成为我的宝可梦吗？”

一天的相处下来，他还是挺喜欢这条藤藤蛇的。“藤藤~？”（好...好突然...）藤藤蛇有些不适应的扭过了头。心中虽然对林枫感观很好。在听到这个询问的时候，也情不自禁的想要答应。但就一天的相处，它觉得是不是有点快了？林枫露出了笑容，“缘分到了，怎么能叫突然呢？何况，是我在很真诚的询问你能否成为我的宝可梦呀。”将口中的神奇糖果吞下，看着眼前的精灵球，藤藤蛇最终还是扭过头去，但却将手放在了精灵球上，“藤藤~！”（既然你都...这么说了，那好吧...）伴随着点点红光，下一刻，藤藤蛇的身影就消散在精灵球中。“啧，还真是只又傲又娇的小家伙。”林枫摇摇头，又将它放了出来。【精灵：藤藤蛇】【性别：雌】【特性：唱反调】【资质：红色】【个体值：HP（23）攻击（21）特攻（25）防御（25）特防（24）速度（31）】【实力：14~19级】【技能：刀叶，青草搅拌器，大蛇瞪眼，藤鞭，寄生种子。】【介绍：它觉得可能遇上了一个不错的人类。】【亲密度：60（它觉得你还不错）】【愉悦值：60（愉悦带着一丝彷徨）】“藤藤~？”“来，带你去见一个新的小伙伴。”林枫拿出了丑丑鱼的精灵球。今天忙活了一天，还没来得及将丑丑鱼放出来呢。“藤藤...”见着跟之前一样，并没有任何变化的林枫，藤藤蛇也不知道为什么，松了一口气，迈着细小的步子，跟了上去。到了蓄水池旁，一天的沉积，蓄水池已经变得清澈了起来。轻轻一点。在精灵球里面待了半天的丑丑鱼顿时游了出来。呆滞的鱼目再次见到林枫，也不由得露出一点欣喜来。
content_en:
dusk.In the two plowed fields, Lin Feng planted many plants used to make good wound medicine. He also bought some paprika, millet, turnip and other vegetable seeds from the seed store in the town and planted them.When I came back, I also bought a fish tank.In order to express gratitude to the pangolin.Lin Feng made another spicy noodles in the evening.This made the pangolin happy. He focused his gaze on the remaining land in the plantation that had not yet been expanded. With that little look in his eyes, he almost said to Lin Feng, "These jobs belong to him too. Remember to call him when the time comes."... "Here, eat some candy." Looking at the pangolin who was about to leave, Lin Feng took out a magical candy and asked, "Panchuan?" The pangolin took it with his paws in confusion."It's delicious." The pangolin sniffed it and ate it without thinking too much.After swallowing it, I felt refreshed after a day's work and seemed to have more energy and strength.The naive pangolin didn't think much about it. After bowing to Lin Feng twice, he left.It can only be seen through Lin Feng's probing eyes.The pangolin originally had an energy level of 11-12, but now it has an energy level of 13-14.Overall, it has improved by two levels!"Teng Teng..." Teng Teng Snake made a resentful voice next to it.It kind of knows it now.As long as it's food made by the human in front of you, it's basically a top-notch delicacy!"Okay, you've been working hard all day and you've pulled up two fields of grass." Lin Feng knelt down and looked at the Vine Snake with an inexplicable smile.Just this smile made the smiling Vine Snake feel inexplicably shy. After taking the candy, he thought for a while, as if he had decided something, and moved his body closer to Lin Feng, then lowered his head.It looked like he was asking Lin Feng to touch its head?"Haha..." Lin Feng couldn't help but laugh. While passing the candy over, he also put his hand on its head as he wished.It has a smooth touch, like jelly, but also has a softness, a gentle touch, and a bit of cold feeling.In other words... um... it felt so good in the hand that it allowed the snake to accept having its head touched. Lin Feng stopped saying anything and continued to hang it. Instead, he took out an elf ball and landed it in front of it with a sincere attitude."Teng Teng?" Teng Teng Snake had just put the magical candy into his mouth, and before he had time to chew it, he saw a big elf ball placed in front of him.The chewing movement stopped immediately, and the whole snake froze in place.Lin Feng said seriously, "Do you want to be my Pokémon?"

After getting along with him for a day, he still liked this vine snake quite a bit."Teng Teng~?" (So...so sudden...) Teng Teng Snake turned his head unaccustomed.Although I have a good impression of Lin Feng in my heart.When I heard this question, I couldn't help but want to agree.But after just one day together, does it feel like it’s a little too fast?Lin Feng smiled, "How can it be called sudden when fate has arrived? Besides, I am sincerely asking you if you can become my Pokémon." After swallowing the magical candy in his mouth and looking at the Poké Ball in front of him, Vine Snake finally turned his head away, but put his hand on the Poké Ball, "Vine Vine~!" (Since you... said so, then okay...) With a little red light, the next moment, Vine Snake's figure disappeared into the Poké Ball."Tsk, what a proud and delicate little guy." Lin Feng shook his head and let it go again.[Elf: Vine Snake] [Gender: Female] [Characteristics: Naysayer] [Qualification: Red] [Individual Value: HP (23) Attack (21) Special Attack (25) Defense (25) Special Defense (24) Speed ​​(31)] [Strength: Level 14~19] [Skills: Blade, Grass Blender, Serpent Glare, Vine Whip, Parasitic Seed.】【Introduction: It thinks it may have met a nice human being.] [Intimacy: 60 (it thinks you are pretty good)] [Pleasure value: 60 (pleasure with a hint of hesitation)] "Teng Teng~?" "Here, let's take you to meet a new friend." Lin Feng took out the Elf Ball of Chou Chou Fish.I’ve been busy all day today and haven’t had time to release the ugly fish yet."Teng Teng..." Seeing Lin Feng who was the same as before, Teng Teng Snake didn't know why, he breathed a sigh of relief and followed with small steps.When we arrived at the reservoir, the reservoir had become clear after a day of sedimentation.Just a little bit.The ugly fish that had been in the elf ball for a long time swam out immediately.The dull fish eyes couldn't help but show a little joy when they saw Lin Feng again.
